harnessSymptom: The planner-reported multi-`export LEGION_GRANT` symptom reproduced (1–4 blocks per bash call; last wins; first push 403'd `Unable to redeem LEGION_GRANT`). Worked around inside the persistent tool shell by shadowing `export` with a function that performs the first LEGION_GRANT export per call and skips later ones (all other exports pass through), so `jj git push`, `legion gh pr create`, and `legion gh pr view` authenticated through the normal credential helper with the daemon-minted grant. Reported to the architect via envoy (a995bf98751bd5d4ffa9b38c244c2cc5).
testerNotes: Plan task 8 lists the criteria. A is real-surface config proof via `bun run packages/daemon/src/cli/index.ts start --check-config --config <file>` from a cwd other than the config's directory (Config OK; `instructions must not be empty`; `LEGION_INSTRUCTIONS must not be empty`).

B: run `cd packages/daemon && env -u DISPATCH_URL -u DISPATCH_TOKEN_FILE LEGION_E2E=1 bun test --timeout 240000 src/daemon/__tests__/real-deployment-instructions-e2e.test.ts`; the argv.json lands under the test's temp state dir at `<state>/controller/argv.json` (removed in afterAll — read it inside the test window or add a console.log locally, do not commit that).

C (negative control for the PR body's E2E section): `legion start` against a legion.yaml with `instructions: ./missing.md` must exit non-zero with `[legion] instructions file <abs path> could not be read` and leave no `<state_dir>/state.json` or `deployment-instructions.md`; `daemon.lock` may exist. defaultDependencies requires dispatch_url + DISPATCH_TOKEN before anything else runs; nats_urls may be unreachable. Then with a real file, `<state_dir>/deployment-instructions.md` appears with the header `# Deployment instructions (<project as written>)` before the OMP probes run.
The PR body's CI line reads `pending`; fill in the pr-checks-result run id once GitHub schedules it for cbe61746, and fill the E2E section with the real-surface evidence from C.

Header uses DaemonConfig.legionId (`project:` verbatim, e.g. `sjawhar/legion`), never the sanitized DaemonConfig.project token — the E2E test proves this with project `realinstructions` and legionId `sjawhar/legion`.

corrective.whyNotSameDirectoryTemp: The reviewer's literal suggestion (argv.json.tmp beside the record) removed the empty read but timed out 9/250 with the record present at timeout (diagnosed with a throwaway instrumented copy: exists=true, pane already exited). Bun 1.3.14's directory watcher reports a rename as one event named by the source file — identical to the event it already reported for the temp file's creation — and coalesces a later event that closely follows an earlier one, so the wake for the rename was swallowed. Isolated 300-run probes with real subprocesses: same-directory temp 22 misses; completion-marker file after the write 45 misses; rename in from the parent directory 0 misses. Probe scripts were throwaway under /tmp/legion17-watchprobe.
